headline: Agrarian district with solid road scores but limited mapped daily services

tags.reason: The infrastructure index stands at 73 compared to the national median of 45, though 80.3% of road surfaces remain unrecorded.

summary: Tərtər has a population density of 186 people per km², substantially higher than the national rayon median of 81. Its infrastructure index reaches 73 compared to the national median of 45, supported by a 7.6% paved share of known roads against the median 4.35%. However, daily convenience is constrained with zero recorded pharmacies and only 1.18 schools per 10,000 residents against national medians of 0.18 and 4.14 respectively. Public transit relies on 1 mapped railway station and 0.13 bus stops per 10,000 residents, below the median of 0.27.
